exercises.title: BA skills 1 — which skill is at work?
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers lists fourteen essential skills of a business analyst. Name the main skill each BA is using.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Wiegers liệt kê mười bốn kỹ năng thiết yếu của BA. Gọi tên kỹ năng chính mà mỗi BA đang dùng.

Mỗi dòng được chấm riêng; giải thích từng đáp án hiện sau khi nộp.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# BA skills 1 — which skill is at work? — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Listening
   - r1.k: Interviewing and questioning
   - r2.k: Thinking on your feet
   - r3.k: Systems thinking
   - r4.k: Facilitation
   - r5.k: Observational
   - r6.k: Organizational
   - r7.k: Modeling
   - r8.k: Creativity
   - r9.k: Communication
   A BA uses many skills at once; the exam usually asks you to recognise the dominant one from the behaviour described.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A BA uses many skills at once; the exam usually asks you to recognise the dominant one from the behaviour described.

bang.de:
Choose the right value for every row.

Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.

o.s: Lan restates what the head nurse said and notices the nurse hesitated when talking about night shifts.
Minh asks: "And what happens if the scanner cannot read the wristband?"
In the middle of a meeting, Hoa spots that the new request contradicts what finance said yesterday.
Tuan checks whether changing the discount rule in the shop affects the accounting and loyalty systems.
Thu runs a workshop of 12 people from 4 departments and keeps it neutral and on track.
Watching cashiers, Nam sees them write customer phone numbers on paper — something nobody mentioned.
Linh turns 300 sticky notes, e-mails and interview notes into a structured requirements repository.
An draws a state diagram so developers see every status of an order.
Khoa proposes a "repeat last order" feature that customers had never thought of, and asks them first.
Mai writes a one-page summary for executives and a detailed version for developers.

bang.giaiThich: A BA uses many skills at once; the exam usually asks you to recognise the dominant one from the behaviour described.

exercises.title: BA skills 2 — analytical skill and creativity
exercises.problemHtml:
Analytical skill: move between high and low levels of abstraction, reconcile conflicting information, separate wants from real needs, and distinguish solution ideas from requirements. Creativity: invent potential requirements for customers to consider — but avoid gold plating: never add requirements without customer approval.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Kỹ năng phân tích và sáng tạo — nhưng không mạ vàng.

Yêu cầu

  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: BA skills 3 — learning, interpersonal, leadership
exercises.problemHtml:
Learning: absorb new domains fast and be honest about what you do not know — not knowing is fine, hiding ignorance is not. Interpersonal: get people with competing interests to work as a team, speak the audience’s language. Leadership: influence stakeholders toward a common goal, negotiate and resolve conflicts.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:

exercises.title: BA skills 4 — which model for which audience?
exercises.problemHtml:
Modeling skill: some models help communicate with users, others with developers, others only support the analyst’s own analysis. Choose the most suitable model for each purpose.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Check that every combination of member type and order size has a discount rule.
